push.title: D 3-3 vs FC Anish | You: 8.9
push.body:
PhogsToffees, an 8.9. If confidence were contagious, you just gave the whole team a cold.

THE GOOD
+ 2 key passes. You made your teammates look like heroes. That's real leadership.
+ A goal against FC Anish, your 2nd straight match scoring. The goal was open and you walked right through the door.
+ Man of the Match, your 31st for us. You carried the moment and carried us.
+ Tackles won 3, up from your usual 1. Proof you've got another gear.
+ That connection with buddskees is gold. Don't let it rust.

THE BAD
- 66% passing (19 of 29, down from your usual 76%). Real talk: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle. Easy money.
- Shots 1, down from your usual 3. We'll drill that till it's boring.
- 3 tackles won cost 0.1. One thing at a time.

Kickabout task: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.

PhogsToffees, one more thing before you log off: Don't be afraid of the dark. That's when the stars come out.

Gold star, big hug, see you next match. - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 3-3 vs FC Anish | You: 7.3
push.body:
buddskees, a 7.3 against FC Anish. You battled, and battling's the part you can always control.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at FC Anish's goal. Volume creates chances, and you created plenty.
+ 3 goals conceded gave a +0.1 boost.
+ 3-3 draw. Neither team blinked.

THE BAD
- Match rating 7.3, down from your usual 8.3. That's the gap between a good night and a great one.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. Easy money: Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.
- Tackle success 0%, down from your usual 28%. Habit to build: Get low and side-on. Square-on defenders get nutmegged.
- Shots on target: 67%. Decent, but top-quarter forwards get to 90%+. That's the next rung.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 53%, down from your usual 76%. That's a red-ink, see-me-after-class kind of number. Between you and me: Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.

Teach your feet: Weight matters as much as direction. Firm along the ground beats soft and loopy.

Remember, buddskees: A good teammate is like a good umbrella. You don't notice 'em till it rains.

Tomorrow's a fresh pitch. Let's go make some divots. - Coach Lasso
